How It Works

01

Install Skill

One command installs ClawScan as an OpenClaw skill. Pure bash, zero dependencies.

$ openclaw skill install clawscan
02

Run Security Scan

24 checks across config, files, skills, and network exposure. A-F grading system.

$ openclaw run clawscan
03

Fix Issues

Get actionable findings with fix recommendations. Secure your setup before exploits.
